answers.valueEn: Cracking in front and rear control arm bushings and rear stabilizers. Corrosion/salting on the turbo pipe from turbo to engine oil pan. Needs tire replacement. Oil leak from turbo horn hose. Signs of dismantling engine oil pan bolts and non-original silicone. Signs of dismantling tappet cover housing bolts. Break in the engine shield and front right plastic pan secured with plastic ties. Slight hesitation occurring sometimes when pressing the accelerator fully.
